title: What Plants and Animals Need
seo_title: Kindergarten Living Things Worksheets: What Plants and Animals Need to Live
standard_text: Use observations to describe patterns of what plants and animals (including humans) need to survive.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten science worksheets on what plants and animals need (NGSS K-LS1-1): food, water, air and light, and what animals eat. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Animals need food, water and air. Plants need water and light.
body_html:
How to think about it

Living things have needs.

  • Animals: food, water, air.
  • Plants: water and light.
  • Some animals eat plants. Some eat animals.
Example

What does a dog need to live?

It is an animal.

Answer: food, water and air

Example

What does a plant need to live?

Plants make food with light.

Answer: water and light

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants eat food like we do.
  • Thinking rocks need water. They are not alive.
  • Thinking all animals eat plants.

faq.a: Food, water and air. People are animals too, so we need them as well.
Water and light. Plants make their own food in their leaves.

faq.q: Do all animals eat the same food?
faq.a: No. Rabbits eat plants, frogs eat bugs and bears eat both plants and animals.
